publication.follow_up: This publication evidence is stored by a subsequent metadata-only commit, which is subject to the same required deployment workflow. It does not claim a new native Home Assistant installation or physical-device test.

limitations: A finite source registry is complete only for its pinned version and recorded extraction scope.
Third-party cards, integration-specific vendor terms and future additions require a new mapping; the fallback pattern is not implementation proof.
Reference examples use synthetic data and do not change a household.
Automated documentation checks do not certify full assistive-technology or native Home Assistant conformance.
